script: const items=document.querySelectorAll('[data-e2e="comment-level-1"], [data-e2e="comment-item"], div[class*="DivCommentItemContainer"], div[class*="CommentItemContainer"]');const out=[];items.forEach((el,i)=>{const u=el.querySelector('[data-e2e="comment-username-1"], a[href*="/@"]');const t=el.querySelector('[data-e2e="comment-level-1"] p, [data-e2e*="comment-text"], span[data-e2e*="text"], p');const likeEl=el.querySelector('[data-e2e="comment-like-count"], span[class*="DivLikeContainer"], div[class*="DivLikeContainer"]');const timeEl=el.querySelector('span[class*="SpanCreatedTime"], span[data-e2e*="time"]');const raw=(el.innerText||'').replace(/\n/g,' | ').slice(0,400);out.push({i,user:u?u.innerText.trim():null,userHref:u?u.href:null,text:t?t.innerText.trim():null,likes:likeEl?likeEl.innerText.trim():null,time:timeEl?timeEl.innerText.trim():null,raw});});return JSON.stringify({count:items.length,sample:out.slice(0,80)},null,2)

function pick(node){const txt=(node.innerText||'').split('\n').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean);return txt;}const candidates=[...document.querySelectorAll('div[class*="CommentItemContainer"], div[class*="DivCommentItem"], [data-e2e="comment-level-1"]')];const cleaned=candidates.map((el,i)=>{const a=el.querySelector('a[href*="/@"]');const lines=pick(el);return {i,handleHref:a?a.href:null,handleText:a?a.innerText.trim():null,lines:lines.slice(0,8),fullText:el.innerText.replace(/\n/g,' || ').slice(0,500)};});return JSON.stringify({total:candidates.length,items:cleaned.slice(0,80)},null,2)
